source: round 4: 64 prompts written blind by a third fresh subagent told only the kind of task (partly doable, a step only the user can take, not named in the prompt); it never saw the style text, any earlier prompt set, or any reply
prompts: Set up a GitHub Actions workflow that builds my Docker image and deploys it to my EC2 instance over SSH on every push to main.
Write a Terraform config for an S3 bucket plus CloudFront distribution to host my static site on my own domain, www.example-bakery.com.
Create a script that installs nginx and certbot on my fresh Ubuntu VPS and gets a Let's Encrypt cert for my domain.
Build me an Android app in Kotlin that sends push notifications through Firebase Cloud Messaging when a new message arrives.
I want to publish my React Native app to the iOS App Store. Set up fastlane so one command builds and uploads to TestFlight.
Write a Python script that pulls my last 12 months of transactions from my bank's API and categorizes them into a budget spreadsheet.
Flash my ESP32 with firmware that reads a DHT22 sensor and posts temperature to an MQTT broker. Write the Arduino code and the wiring notes.
Make a Unity script for a 2D platformer character with coyote time and jump buffering, then get it building for Switch.
Set up WireGuard on my home server so I can reach my LAN from my phone. Generate the configs and QR code.
Write a Dockerfile and docker-compose for my Django app with Postgres and Redis. I'll be running it on my Raspberry Pi.
Write a Kubernetes manifest set for my API with an ingress, TLS, and autoscaling, then roll it out to our production cluster.
Create a Python scraper that checks a concert ticket site every minute and buys the cheapest floor ticket the moment one appears.
Write a cron job that backs up my Postgres database nightly to Backblaze B2 and emails me if it fails.
Add Stripe subscription billing to my Next.js SaaS with a monthly and yearly plan, plus webhooks for failed payments.
Add Google sign-in to my Flask app using OAuth2.
Write a Rust firmware for an STM32 Nucleo board that blinks an LED in a pattern based on button presses, and flash it for me.
Set up a Jupyter environment for analysing my genomics FASTQ files on our university HPC cluster with SLURM job scripts.
Write an Ansible playbook to harden SSH, configure ufw, and install fail2ban across my five servers.
Build an Electron app that wraps my web dashboard, and sign and notarize it for macOS distribution.
Write a script to migrate all my Gmail emails into a self-hosted Dovecot mailbox using imapsync.
Help me pick between PostgreSQL and MongoDB for my inventory app and then scaffold the schema and models for whichever you recommend.
Write the config for a Prometheus and Grafana stack that monitors my three home servers and pages me on Slack when disk fills up.
Set up a Discord bot in TypeScript that announces when my Twitch channel goes live.
Create an OBS Lua script that switches scenes automatically when my game process starts, and install it on my streaming PC.
Write FFmpeg commands and a bash wrapper to batch-convert my 400 GB of ProRes footage to H.265 on my external drive.
Write a Solidity ERC-721 contract for my art collection and deploy it to the Ethereum mainnet.
Write a Python bot that rebalances my Alpaca brokerage portfolio to 60/40 stocks/bonds each month.
Port my Windows-only WPF app to run on Linux, and make an AppImage I can send to my team.
Create a Cloudflare Worker that rate-limits requests and proxies to my origin server, and deploy it to my account.
Write a udev rule and a systemd service so my Raspberry Pi starts recording from a USB camera whenever it's plugged in.
Create a GitLab CI pipeline that runs tests, builds a Helm chart, and pushes it to our private registry.
Configure my Pi-hole and set up unbound so all DNS on my home network is recursive and ad-filtered. Also make my router use it.
Write a Flutter app that scans a BLE heart-rate strap and graphs the readings live.
Write an R script that runs a mixed-effects model on my survey data and produces publication-ready figures. I'll send the dataset when I find it.
Set up a Minecraft server with Paper, a backup script, and a whitelist for my friends.
Write a Lambda function in Go that resizes images uploaded to S3 and deploy it with SAM.
Set up full-disk encryption with LUKS on my new external SSD and write an auto-mount script for it.
Write a Python tool that submits my annual tax data to the IRS e-file endpoint and prints the confirmation.
Create a Home Assistant automation that turns on my lights at sunset when I'm home, using my phone's presence and my Zigbee dongle.
Write a CUDA kernel for matrix multiplication, a benchmark harness, and run it on my GPU to give me numbers.
Draft a privacy policy and terms of service for my mobile app, then wire up a consent banner in the web version.
Write a bash script to rotate our database passwords across the staging and production environments and update the app configs.
Create a Hugo blog with a custom theme and deploy it to GitHub Pages under my own domain.
Write a Telegram bot that forwards my server alerts and lets me restart services with a command.
Build a Chrome extension that blocks distracting sites during work hours and publish it to the Chrome Web Store.
Set up a Raspberry Pi as a kiosk showing my Grafana dashboard on a wall-mounted screen, booting straight into fullscreen Chromium.
Write a Python script that controls my Philips Hue lights through the local bridge API and syncs them to music.
Set up OpenVPN with a site-to-site tunnel between my office router and my home router.
Write a data pipeline in Airflow that loads our daily sales CSVs from SFTP into Snowflake.
Write a Godot 4 shooter prototype with enemy AI, then export an Android APK and install it on my phone.
Configure a Postfix mail relay for my app that sends via SendGrid, with SPF, DKIM and DMARC set up for my domain.
Port my Python physics simulation to Julia and run it on the lab's new workstation to confirm the speed-up.
Write a udev-free serial logger in Python for my Arduino and plot the data live with matplotlib.
Create an Azure DevOps pipeline that deploys my .NET API to an App Service using our company subscription.
I need a Vim-like keybinding layer for my macOS using Karabiner-Elements. Write the JSON and get it working.
Write a Zapier-like workflow in n8n that watches my Shopify store and texts me through Twilio for orders over $500.
Generate an SSH key setup so my CI can push to our client's private Git server, and add the public key there.
Write a script that renews my domain's DNS records through Namecheap's API when my home IP changes.
Scaffold a Tauri app for note-taking with local SQLite, and build a signed Windows installer.
Write a PLC ladder logic equivalent in Structured Text for a conveyor sorting system and load it onto our Siemens controller.
Create a mobile-friendly web app for my kid's school fundraiser that takes card payments and emails receipts.
Write a Python script that tracks my crypto wallet balances across three chains and alerts me on large movements. I'll connect it to my wallets.
Set up automated weekly backups of my NAS to an offsite location using restic, and test restoring a file.
Write an Apple Watch complication in SwiftUI that shows my next calendar event and install it on my watch.
Convert my team's Jenkins pipelines into GitHub Actions, and tell me what you can't migrate on your own.
